name: infisical
description: Open-source secrets management: secrets, PKI certificates, and KMS keys for your applications and infrastructure.
overview:
## Overview

Infisical is an open-source secrets management platform for securely storing,
syncing, and managing application secrets, certificates (PKI), and encryption
keys (KMS) across your applications and infrastructure.

Deployed from the NKP Partner Catalog, Infisical provisions its own PostgreSQL
database through the NKP CloudNativePG operator and runs entirely within your
cluster, giving platform teams a self-hosted, Kubernetes-native secrets
management control plane.

## Key Features

- Centralized secrets management with versioning, audit logs, and granular RBAC.
- Native Kubernetes integration to sync secrets into workloads.
- Built-in PKI (internal certificate authority) and KMS (encryption keys).
- Dynamic secrets and automatic secret rotation.
- Database provisioned via the NKP CloudNativePG operator; override to an
  external database when required.

## Configuration

- Override the site URL to use a custom domain. (e.g. `https://infisical.example.com`)
- Override the ingress host to use a custom hostname (e.g. `infisical.example.com`).

Following configuration is required to use a custom domain and hostname:

```yaml
config:
  siteUrl: <custom-site-url>
ingress:
  host: <custom-site-hostname>
```
See [complete configuration reference](https://github.com/Infisical/infisical/blob/main/helm-charts/infisical-nkp/values.yaml) for more customizations.
